name: Grand Sunergy Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Grand Sunergy Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in comprehensive urban landscaping, providing services from design and planning to execution. The company also cultivates and supplies plant seedlings. Its primary focus lies in municipal greening initiatives, encompassing projects like enhancing government administrative areas, city streets and thoroughfares, central parks, large-scale plains afforestation, scenic spots, and real estate properties. Established on November 5, 2002, the company is headquartered in Beijing, China.
